header.title: AI Quiz
header.description: Generate a quick multiple-choice quiz on any topic with AI. Nothing is saved — it's just for you.

configure.topicLabel: What do you want to be quizzed on?
configure.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Photosynthesis, the French Revolution, Newton's Laws…

tip.title: How this works
tip.body: Pick a topic — anything you're studying — and the AI will write you a few multiple-choice questions with explanations. There are no time limits, no scores sent anywhere, and nothing saved. Just a low-pressure way to test yourself before an exam.
